basic_info.description: Buyers:  Don't miss this opportunity to own a beautifully renovated home in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods!  This stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom TIC flat with independent garage parkingincluding a 220V power outletis the final available unit in a boutique 4-unit building, where all other homes are owner-occupied.    Perfectly located across from the highly regarded Argonne Elementary School and just one block from Golden Gate Park, this home offers the ultimate in lifestyle convenience. Stroll to popular local shops, cafes, and restaurantsall within easy reach.    Fully renovated from top to bottom, this residence features:    All-new windows, walls, flooring, electrical, plumbing, and furnace    High-efficiency tankless water heater for endless hot water    Contemporary LED recessed lighting throughout    Designer kitchen with high-end appliances and in-unit washer/dryer    Sunlit interiors with expansive windows that create a warm, welcoming feel    This bright and inviting home blends quality craftsmanship with modern comforttruly a place you'll be proud to call home.
